textDiff.originalPlaceholder: Paste or type the first text
textDiff.changedPlaceholder: Paste the version to compare it with
textDiff.copyFailed: Copy failed — your browser blocked clipboard access.
textDiff.optionsNote: These options only decide what counts as a difference. The text stays exactly as pasted.
textDiff.statsAria: {hunks} differences: {added} added lines, {removed} removed lines, {unchanged} unchanged, out of {lines} lines on both sides.
textDiff.coarse: These texts differ too much to line up exactly. The block below is shown as one replacement, not a minimal diff.
textDiff.cappedNote: Only the first rows are listed below.
textDiff.capped: {rows} rows shown · {rest} more lines not listed
textDiff.empty: Paste two texts to see their differences, or load the example.
textDiff.identical: No differences. The two texts are the same.
textDiff.identicalOptions: No differences with these options on.
textDiff.tooManyChars: Each text can be at most {max} characters here. Shorten one of them to compare.
textDiff.tooManyLines: Each text can be at most {max} lines here. Shorten one of them to compare.
textDiff.privacy: Both texts stay in this browser tab. Nothing is uploaded, nothing is saved, and no part of your text goes into the address bar or a shareable link — leaving the page clears it. The two options only change how differences are judged; your text is always shown exactly as you pasted it.
textDiff.howItWorks: Lines are aligned by longest common subsequence: identical starts and ends are trimmed first, and repeated text is split on lines that occur exactly once on both sides. Each difference is one block, deletes and inserts inside it pair up line by line, and a paired line is also marked word by word. Unchanged runs longer than {context} lines are folded away, and Copy diff uses the same folding with LF line breaks. CJK text is compared one character at a time because it has no spaces, and an emoji sequence counts as one piece. A line ending is a difference too: CRLF, CR and a missing final newline are labelled on the row, otherwise the change would be invisible.
textDiff.exampleOriginal:
# Shopping list

- coffee
- bread
- 6 eggs
- dishwasher tablets

Buy the eggs before Friday.
textDiff.exampleChanged:
# Shopping list

- coffee
- sourdough bread
- 6 eggs

Buy the eggs before Friday.

qrStudio.textPlaceholder: Anything you want the code to carry
qrStudio.urlNote: The address is only encoded. Nothing is opened, requested or checked here.
qrStudio.wifiNote: Separators in the name and the password are escaped, so a scanner reads them back exactly as typed.
qrStudio.eccNote: A higher level survives more damage, but needs a denser symbol.
qrStudio.lowContrastBody: These colours are {ratio}:1 apart, and most scanners need at least {min}:1. The code is valid, but it may not read.
qrStudio.invertedNote: Cameras expect dark modules on a light background. Inverted colours work on many readers, not all.
qrStudio.exportFailed: The browser would not render the image. Try a smaller size.
qrStudio.empty: Enter something to see a code.
qrStudio.tooLong: This content is longer than {max} bytes, which no QR symbol can carry. Shorten it, or lower the error correction.
qrStudio.privacy: The code is built in this browser tab. Nothing is uploaded or stored, and no part of your content goes into the address bar or a shareable link. A Wi-Fi password is never written into a file name, a log or storage, and the encoded text is not printed on screen.
qrStudio.howItWorks: The library only produces the module grid; this page draws the preview and both files itself, so the quiet zone, colours and export size are exactly what you see. Exports use a whole-pixel module size centred inside the requested box, which keeps the edges crisp in PNG and SVG. A QR symbol needs a four-module quiet zone, and this control never goes below that. Version 1 is 21 × 21 modules and every step adds four, so the version grows with the content and the correction level.

jsonFormatter.waiting: Formatted JSON appears here. Nothing is checked until you type or paste something.
jsonFormatter.valid: Valid JSON · {objects} objects · {arrays} arrays · {keys} keys · {values} values · depth {depth}
jsonFormatter.noRepair: Nothing is repaired, reordered or dropped: fix the input and the output changes with it.
jsonFormatter.copyFailed: Copy failed — your browser blocked clipboard access.
jsonFormatter.reasonTooLarge: This document is longer than {max} characters, so it is not parsed here.
jsonFormatter.reasonOutputTooLarge: Formatting would exceed {max} output characters. Choose Minified or reduce the document or indentation.
jsonFormatter.reasonTooDeep: This document nests deeper than {max} levels, which is more than this tool will walk.
jsonFormatter.reasonUnexpectedEnd: The document ends in the middle of a value.
jsonFormatter.reasonUnexpectedToken: Unexpected {found} where a value was expected.
jsonFormatter.reasonBadEscape: That is not a valid string escape ({found}).
jsonFormatter.reasonBadNumber: That is not a JSON number ({found}).
jsonFormatter.reasonMissingColon: A key is missing the colon after it.
jsonFormatter.reasonMissingComma: Two values are missing a comma between them ({found}).
jsonFormatter.reasonTrailingComma: A comma sits just before {found}, and JSON does not allow one.
jsonFormatter.reasonDuplicateKey: The key “{key}” appears more than once, so one value would be silently lost.
jsonFormatter.reasonExtraData: There is extra content after the value ({found}).
jsonFormatter.privacy: Your document stays in this browser tab. Nothing is uploaded, nothing is saved, and no part of it goes into the address bar or a shareable link; the download is named formatted.json so a key cannot leak through a file name. Objects, arrays and any valid top-level value are accepted, and the text is shown as text — a document containing markup is never interpreted.
jsonFormatter.howItWorks: The document is parsed here rather than with JSON.parse, so numbers keep the exact digits you wrote — a 30-digit integer, 1e2, 1.50 and -0 are not rewritten — strings keep their escapes, and object keys stay in the order you wrote them. A key that appears twice is reported instead of the last value silently winning. Parsing stops above {max} characters or {depth} nesting levels so a hostile or accidental input cannot wedge the tab.

unitConverter.valueHint: Decimals, a leading minus and exponents like 1.5e-3 are accepted.
unitConverter.copyFailed: Copy failed — your browser blocked clipboard access.
unitConverter.waiting: The converted value appears here. Nothing is calculated until you enter a number.
unitConverter.noFactor: Temperature scales start at different points, so this pair has no single multiplier — it converts through kelvin.
unitConverter.sameUnit: Source and target are the same unit, so nothing changes — choose a different target to see the conversion.
unitConverter.reasonEmpty: Enter the number you want to convert.
unitConverter.reasonInvalid: “{found}” is not a number. Use digits, at most one sign and an optional exponent; unit symbols and thousands separators are not read.
unitConverter.reasonOverflow: {found} is too large: the result does not fit a double-precision number.
unitConverter.reasonUnderflow: {found} is too small: the result would round to zero, so it is not shown.
unitConverter.reasonAbsoluteZero: There is no temperature below absolute zero to convert. On this scale it is {min}.
unitConverter.reasonMixed: These two units measure different things, so no conversion exists between them.
unitConverter.reasonUnknown: This unit is not in the table.
unitConverter.privacy: Only the number you typed is used, and only in this tab: nothing is uploaded, nothing is saved, and no part of it goes into the address bar or a shareable link. Copy puts the number itself on the clipboard.
unitConverter.howItWorks: Each category converts through one base unit — metre, square metre, litre, kilogram, kelvin, metre per second, second — and the area, volume and speed factors are derived from the length and time tables, so a square or cubic ratio really is the square or cube of the length one. Temperature is affine, so it keeps its own offsets instead of a multiplier. Results are shown to {digits} significant digits, while the calculation uses the full double and never reads the rounded display back as input.
unitConverter.noRates: Currency is deliberately absent: an exchange rate needs a live data source, and this page works with no server at all. Units whose size depends on tradition — cup, tablespoon, teaspoon, month — are left out too. Where a unit exists in both US and Imperial form, both are listed and named.

chat.versionChanged: This conversation uses an older book version. Start a new chat to ask about the current version.
chat.citationMissing: Section {section}, item {item} — unavailable in this version
chat.tokenScope: Reported usage for this turn's main conversation, including context and book results. Total includes reported cache tokens. Unreported calls are excluded; this is not a bill.
chat.timingNote: Local elapsed time is approximate after Stop or disconnection. Reload to retrieve final server timing when available.
chat.titleLength: Enter a title between 1 and 100 characters.
chat.historyBusy: This conversation is still running. Open it and confirm Stop first.
chat.quotaScope: Requests that reach the AI service count, including failed or stopped requests. Failures before an upstream attempt are released. This is a request limit, not a token or billing limit.
chat.confirming: Checking the server result. No new AI request is being sent.
chat.stop_unconfirmed: The final server state is not yet confirmed. Check again before switching conversations.
chat.logout_failed: Could not log out. Try again.
chat.interrupted: This request was interrupted. Its saved response is incomplete.
chat.archivedNotice: This conversation is archived. Restore it from History to continue.
chat.copyFailed: Could not copy. Please select and copy the text manually.
chat.sourceUnavailable: The original entry is unavailable for this answer’s source version. The reference may be missing or invalid.
chat.previewScope: Original excerpt only. Check the full entry and conditions; locating it does not verify the answer.
chat.sourceLocationMissing: This entry cannot be located in the reader.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.message: An unexpected error occurred. Try again — if it keeps happening, please open an issue on GitHub.

operations.title: Service operations
operations.description: Administrator-only aggregate service and backup status. No reader messages, email list or provider logs.
operations.loadFailed: Could not refresh. Check your login and try again.
operations.truncated: Showing only the latest 10,000 attempts in this period. These totals are incomplete.
operations.serviceNote: Application guards only. This does not measure provider availability or concurrency capacity.
operations.integrityVerified: SQLite integrity and foreign-key checks passed.
operations.backupNote: Freshness threshold: 36 hours. This status verifies local backups only; it does not verify off-machine protection.
operations.attemptNote: Retries are separate attempts. Pre-upstream releases do not consume AI quota; unfinished reservations remain counted.
operations.cacheSamples: Cache read reported by {read} samples; cache write by {write} samples.
operations.tokenNote: Totals include only reported main-loop turn usage, including tool rounds. Missing usage is not zero; auxiliary usage and provider bills are not inferred.
operations.statisticsNote: Statistics include failures and stops when they report measurements. Missing or estimated timings are excluded. P95 is shown only with at least 20 samples; these figures are descriptive, not a model ranking.
